title: Rollout courier checklist and hourly watch notes - Dec 2026 (draft)
content:
Purpose:
This is a working-runner doc for the Dec 2026 ‘courier’ rollout window. Goal: coordinated, low-risk push of the routing + telemetry changes that alter model fallback behavior and sampling. Use this as the day-of checklist, hourly watch notes, and an editable release-notes draft.

Scope:
- Services: routing-service, model-proxy, telemetry-ingestion, console-rollout UI
- Regions: us-west1 (primary), eu-west1 (canary), fallback to us-east1 if needed
- Risk: medium (routing changes touch live traffic split logic)

High-level timeline (UTC):
- T-72h: Finalize PR approvals and perf smoke script updates
- T-24h: Preflight run on staging canary (eu-west1)
- T-3h: Pre-deploy checklist completed; ops channel staffed
- T+0: Release push begins (staggered by region)
- T+30m: Initial telemetry gating review
- T+2h: Broader traffic ramp if gates OK
- T+8h: Stabilization window & post-release retro notes

Preflight checklist (must be green before T-3h):
- PRs merged and CI green (links: JIRA-RELEASE-2041, PR #482).
- Smoke scripts updated to include new fallback traces (scripts/smoke-routing.sh).
- Canaries: run 3x synthetic flows against eu-west1; no >1% error rate across samples.
- Backfill config saved: infra/backups/routing-config-2026-11-19.tar.gz.
- DB migrations: none. Verify schema parity for config reads.
- Observability: dashboards preloaded (Latency/Liveness/Errors) and alerting channels tested.
- Pager rota & on-call: confirmed (see linked calendar invite).
- Communications draft created (this doc).

Day-of (T-3h to T+8h) — Roles & Owners:
- Release Lead (overall): Priya Nair
- Traffic Shepherd (execute traffic shift): Evan Zhang
- Observability Lead (telemetry gating): Maya Lin
- Rollback Lead / Hotpatch-owner: Rafael Cortez
- Customer Comms / CS brief: Hannah Ortiz (CS)
- SRE liaison (infra rollback assist): Omar Iqbal

Hour-by-hour watch cadence (quick):
- T-3h: Final preflight checklist ticked, announce in #release-courier.
- T-2h: Run full smoke on staging; confirm perf baseline.
- T-1h: Brief all owners on Slack bridge; confirm bridge URL and escalation ladder.
- T-15m: Freeze non-essential changes; CI gate set to deny merges.
- T+0: Begin push to us-west1 (batch 1: 10% traffic).
- T+10m: Observability check (errors, 95p latency, token throughput).
- T+30m: Evaluate telemetry gate (see gating threshold below). If OK -> batch 2 (50%).
- T+1h: Evaluate again; if OK -> batch 3 (100%).
- T+2h to T+8h: Hourly check-ins, final stabilization at T+8h.

Smoke tests & quick commands (ops):
- smoke-routing.sh: runs 50 synthetic requests across variants and records latency+errors.
- curl -s -H 'X-Test: courier' https://proxy-us-west1.internal/route/test | jq '.status'
- grep 'fallback' logs: gcloud logging read "resource.type=global AND textPayload:fallback" --limit 50

Telemetry gating (primary metrics and thresholds):
- Error rate (5xx) — gate: must be <0.8% sustained over 10m window.
- Client-visible latency (p95 token generation) — gate: no >20% increase vs baseline.
- Model fallback rate — gate: must not exceed 3% absolute increase vs baseline.
- CPU/GPU load on inference nodes — gate: no node >85% sustained for 5m.
- Alerting: any Sev2/Sev1 fires from routing-service -> immediate pause and triage.

Rollback decision matrix (simple):
- If any gating metric exceeds threshold for 10m -> pause rollout and evaluate.
- If Sev2 persists >15m after mitigation actions -> rollback to previous routing-config.
- If Sev1 at any time -> immediate rollback and engage incident playbook.
- Rollback steps (quick):
  1) Pause traffic shift, set canary to 0%
  2) Apply infra/backups/routing-config-previous (coord with SRE)
  3) Monitor key metrics for 15m
  4) Communicate to #release-courier and CS

Communications plan (short):
- Primary ops channel: #release-courier (public within org).
- Incident bridge: Zoom link pinned in channel (Bridge: zoom.us/j/xxxxxx).
- Exec note: short DM to Eng+Prod leads on major deviation.
- Customer-facing blurb (if degraded): "We’re investigating elevated errors for inference routing; we’ve paused the rollout and will provide updates every 30 minutes."

Release notes (working draft to paste into Console/Change-log):
- Title: Routing and telemetry sampling update (Dec 2026)
- Summary: Adjusts routing fallback thresholds and telemetry sampling to reduce tail-latency regressions while enabling better anomaly detection. Initial rollout staged in us-west1 then eu-west1.
- User impact: No functional changes for customers; potential transient increased request latency during rollout.
- Rollout plan: Gradual traffic ramp with telemetry gates; immediate rollback on Sev1/Sev2 alerts.
- Notable changes: New fallback policy v2 (less aggressive), telemetry sampling increased for rare events.
- Links: JIRA-RELEASE-2041, PR #482, Confluence page (CONFLUENCE-REQ-7832).

Post-release notes & retro prompts (T+8h onward):
- Capture anomaly samples for first 2 hours post-100% ramp.
- Verify cost delta from telemetry sampling change in first 24h.
- Collect feedback from CS on any customer impact.
- Fill incident retro template (linked_artifacts above).

Open questions / TODOs (working):
- Q: Do we want a secondary canary in us-east1 for traffic shaping? (Pros: geo-safety, Cons: adds complexity).
- TODO: Update runbook snippet for rollback automation (Rafael).
- TODO: Add quick links to the ops dashboard (Maya).
- Note to self: Confirm that model-proxy supports older routing-configs for rollback path.

Appendix — quick troubleshooting hints:
- If fallback rate spikes but errors remain low: likely misclassification; flip sampling to verbose and capture 5000 traces.
- If latency increases with stable error-rate: throttle new routing rule and monitor p95 instead of immediate rollback.
- If traffic shepherd loses connectivity: escalate to SRE liaison and pause via API: POST https://infra-api.internal/traffic-pause {"team":"courier"}

Revision history:
- 2026-11-20: initial draft (Priya)
- 2026-11-24: added telemetry gates and owners (Maya, Evan)
- 2026-12-01: updated smoke commands and linked PR reference (Rafael)

Notes to reviewers:
This doc is intentionally concise and day-of focused. Please add any missing quick-commands, link to your PRs, and flag unclear handoffs. If you want a longer runbook, we should spin the stable version into Confluence after this rollout completes successfully.
